description: The Correio window: the bundled splash page and, after it, the hosted app on mepmail.dev. The hosted origin may set the window title, raise notifications and use the agent commands (keep a mailbox's agent key in the credential vault, write an agent's MCP config pointing at this executable); nothing else: no file system, shell or window control. Scoped to the two hosts the navigation guard lets into the window, not to every subdomain.
